summary:
Complete review package for Parallax Edition 02: The Coachella Reckoning. Contains three major sections:

1. SUBSTACK PLATFORM INTELLIGENCE — Research-backed analysis of what's currently driving growth and traction on Substack in 2025-2026, scored against Farrice's specific content approach (length, format, Notes cadence, subject lines), with actionable recommendations and study references.

2. SIDE-BY-SIDE EDITIONS — Version A (Original) at ~1,100 words and Version B (Miller Cognitive Load Rewrite) at ~850 words. The rewrite applies zero-load principles to tighten the narrative, reduce cognitive friction, and optimize for the mobile-first Substack reader without sacrificing Farrice's voice or the emotional architecture of the piece.

3. NOTES BATCH — All 4 Notes for the launch week (Asset Drop, Counterintuitive Truth, Public Reckoning, Bridge to Ed 03) in ready-to-copy format.

4. RECOMMENDATIONS — Strategic verdict on which version to ship and why, plus formatting upgrades for Substack performance.
